title: Voxtral 3
headline: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3 Models and Sovereign Voice SDK
summary: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, a suite of speech-to-text models, text-to-speech models, and a real-time voice agent SDK. The models support multiple languages with features such as diarization, context biasing, and end-of-turn detection. Organizations can access the models via Mistral's EU-hosted API or deploy them on-premises to ensure data sovereignty.
why_it_matters: The availability of sovereign deployment options enables organisations to maintain control over audio data processing and retention when implementing real-time voice AI systems.

quotes.text: Voxtral 3 introduces a cutting-edge voice agent SDK and state-of-the-art speech models designed for real-time, multi-step conversations across 50+ languages.

Available today through Mistral's EU-hosted API or for self-deployment on your own infrastructure, it gives organizations control over where audio is processed, how data is handled, and whether conversations are retained.

classification.significance_reason: A frontier lab product release offering sovereign deployment options for voice agents, but lacking specific regulatory or assurance mandates.
